profile.summary: ANTS Sports is a company that runs youth sports programs for children 12 and under in the Bay Area. It offers after-school enrichment classes, summer and holiday camps, and recess programs in sports such as tennis, basketball, soccer, flag football, martial arts and yoga. It partners with elementary schools and school districts.

Summary, website, phone and email are all supported by the fetched pages and are neutral.
